entities.name: CXCL13
observations: In adipose-derived MSCs, CXCL13 treatment reduced miR-23a; a PI3K/AKT inhibitor reversed the effect (PMID:27509223).

entities.name: MIR23A
observations: Expression decreased after CXCL13 treatment in adipose-derived MSCs in one 2016 study (PMID:27509223).

entities.name: PI3K/AKT signaling
observations: A PI3K/AKT inhibitor reversed CXCL13-associated miR-23a reduction in adipose-derived MSCs; other tested pathway inhibitors did not (PMID:27509223).

entities.name: PMID:27509223
observations: 2016 Biomedicine & Pharmacotherapy study: CXCL13 lowered miR-23a and increased Runx2 in adipose tissue-derived MSCs; PI3K/AKT inhibitor reversed the effects. Available evidence is one study; methodological details were limited.

entities.name: CXCL13-miR23a PI3K finding
observations: In adipose-derived MSCs, CXCL13 reduced miR-23a and increased Runx2; PI3K/AKT inhibition reversed both responses, whereas SAPK/JNK or ERK1/2 inhibition did not (PMID:27509223).
